description: Apple chrome + auth + dashboard. Restyle the navigation (Sidebar, TopBar, BottomNav), the dashboard layout background, the login page (and replace its inline SVG logo with a lucide Building2 icon), and the dashboard stat/section cards. Depends on FEAT-001 (Apple primitives + tokens). No file overlaps with FEAT-003 or FEAT-004. Note: app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx (the bg color change) is distinct from app/layout.tsx (font, owned by FEAT-001).
steps: components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: aside -> 'fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-60 bg-white border-r border-[#E5E5EA] flex flex-col'. Logo tile -> 'bg-[#007AFF] rounded-lg' with white DoorOpen; title span -> 'font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'. Nav link base -> 'flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl mb-0.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors'; active -> 'bg-[#007AFF] text-white'; inactive -> 'text-[#1C1C1E] hover:bg-[#F2F2F7]'; active icon text-white, inactive icon 'text-[#8E8E93]'. Bottom area: separator 'border-[#E5E5EA]', avatar bg 'bg-[#F2F2F7] text-[#1C1C1E]', name 'text-[#1C1C1E] font-semibold', email 'text-[#8E8E93]', sign-out hover 'hover:bg-[#FF3B30]/10 hover:text-[#FF3B30]'. KEEP ALL hrefs UNCHANGED. Optionally add small uppercase text-[#8E8E93] section labels grouping navItems (e.g. Management: Dashboard/Residents/Rooms/Plans; Finance: Rent/Payments/Deposits/Electricity/Expenses; System: Reports/Settings/Activity Log) without changing the link objects.

components/layout/TopBar.tsx: header -> 'h-[52px] bg-white border-b border-[#E5E5EA] flex items-center px-4 md:px-6 gap-3'. Add a centered search pill: import Search from lucide-react;
(visual only; optional local useState). pgName h2 -> 'font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E] text-sm lg:text-base'. Bell button -> 'w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-[#8E8E93] hover:bg-[#F2F2F7] transition-colors'.
components/layout/BottomNav.tsx: border-t border-[#E5E5EA] (replace border-gray-100); active label+icon 'text-[#007AFF]'; inactive 'text-[#8E8E93]' (icon) / 'text-[#8E8E93]' (label). Keep hrefs.
app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx: change the root div className 'bg-[#f5f5f5]' -> 'bg-[#F2F2F7]'. Keep the Sidebar/TopBar/BottomNav composition and the auth redirect unchanged.

app/(auth)/login/page.tsx: outer div -> 'min-h-screen bg-[#F2F2F7] flex items-center justify-center p-4' (remove the green gradient). Logo tile -> 'inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-[#34C759] rounded-2xl mb-4' containing <Building2 className='w-8 h-8 text-white' /> imported from lucide-react (DELETE the inline <svg>). Title -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'. Subtitle -> 'text-sm text-[#8E8E93] mt-2'. Keep the max-w-md wrapper.

components/auth/LoginForm.tsx: Card className -> 'rounded-2xl shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] border-0 p-8' (keep p-8; Card already rounded-2xl + border via FEAT-001, but add explicit border-0 + the bigger shadow). CardTitle -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'. CardDescription -> 'text-sm text-[#8E8E93]'. Labels keep 'text-sm font-medium text-[#1C1C1E]' (Label primitive unchanged). Remove the per-input className='rounded-lg' overrides (Input is Apple now). Error box -> 'bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm' (remove border-red-200). Inline field errors -> 'text-[#FF3B30] text-sm'. Submit Button -> className 'w-full h-[44px] rounded-xl' using the DEFAULT variant (Apple blue) — remove 'bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg h-11'. Keep the Loader2 spinner + disabled state.

app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx: h1 -> 'text-[22px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'; subtitle -> 'text-[#8E8E93] mt-1'. Stat Card: drop the 'border-0 shadow-sm rounded-xl' override (use the new Apple Card defaults); keep the CardContent pt-6. Stat icon tiles: Residents 'bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF]', Occupied Beds 'bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759]', Pending Rent 'bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500]', This Month Income 'bg-[#AF52DE]/10 text-[#AF52DE]' (replace blue-50/green-50/yellow-50/purple-50). Section CardTitle -> 'text-[15px] font-semibold text-[#1C1C1E]'. 'Phase 2 coming soon' text -> 'text-[#8E8E93]'. Keep lucide icons (Users, DoorOpen, Receipt, TrendingUp) and Skeletons.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar active nav item is a blue #007AFF pill with white text+icon (not green); hover is #F2F2F7; hrefs unchanged.
TopBar is 52px tall with a rounded-full #F2F2F7 search pill containing a Search icon; Bell button hover #F2F2F7.
Login page uses bg-[#F2F2F7], a green #34C759 rounded-2xl logo tile with a lucide Building2 icon (no inline SVG), a 22px semibold title, and an Apple blue full-width login button; no green button.
Dashboard heading is 22px semibold #1C1C1E; stat cards are white rounded-2xl with Apple shadow and tinted icon tiles.
Running `npm run build` passes with 0 TypeScript errors.
verification: Optionally npm run dev and visit /login then /dashboard to confirm the blue sidebar pill, the search pill, and the Apple stat cards.
